title: The Endless Ascent
summary: A gondola with one lantern-holding passenger climbs a giant trunk: A it passes the clock of a town carved into the trunk, B it rises out of a cloud sea under the aurora.
request: a vertical 270x480 lofi loop (delivered 4x, 1080x1920): a small gondola with one lantern-holding passenger stays fixed at the screen centre while a 1200 px world strip (root caverns, trunk town, cloud sea, thin air) scrolls down past it forever. This brief covers the two showcase stills and a 5 s sound sample.

outputs.name: sample
outputs.run: pixelate audio music sound/full.wav && python3 sound/make_sample.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i sound/02-sample.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 sound/02-sample.mp3
